[SWS_Rte_91198] Definition of callback function Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkTx
Confirmation
Status:
DRAFT
Previous identifiers: SWS_Rte_91136
⌈
Service Name
Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkTxConfirmation (draft)
Syntax
void Rte_[<Partition>_]COMCbkTxConfirmation (
CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0xA7
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same ComUserCbkHandleId, otherwise Reentrant
ComUserCbkHandleId
Com user callback handle Id corresponding to the PDU that has
been transmitted
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: The PDU was transmitted. E_NOT_OK: Transmission of
the PDU failed.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
This callback generated when TransmissionAcknowledgementRequest is specified for the data
item associated to the large data path (IF) PDU to be transmitted. It indicates to the RTE the
successful or failed transmission of the PDU associated to the data item. The RTE updates the
communication status of the sender related to this data item.
In the prototype, <Partition> is the shortName of the EcucPartition referenced from the
RteComUserEcucPartitionRef parameter (see [ECUC_Rte_09212]) of the RteComUser
for which the Callback is being generated.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
Rte_Com.h
⌋
It is configured in ComUserModuleCnf :
via
the
ComUserCallbackName
(See
[ECUC_Com_10036])
parameter
where
the
ComUserCallbackType
(See
[ECUC_Com_10034])
is
set
to
COM_TX_CONFIRMATION
